recentItems.description: Turnback Tuesday: here's another archived LF capture, this time it's the Tacoma IS2 XD (ID #36774) from two years ago today. This was recorded with my Hauppauge WinTV-HVR-1955 tuner at a motel in nearby Fife during a one-night stop in the Tacoma area on a drive home from my parents' house on the east side of the state. The Weather Channel was viewable on digital clear QAM channel 53.1 at the motel as part of their custom Xfinity HD clear QAM cable headend system. Music is "Happy Travels" by Brian Wayy. No copyright infringement is intended.
